name: Sunscale Dragon - Young
description: Young Sunscale is a neutral-leaning firmament intelligent true dragon with violet scales that kindle molten gold in sunlight. It seeks to test mortals through riddles, wagers, and fire. At this age it is an emerging but formidable predator.

attacks.name: Molten Jaws
attacks.description: The dragon strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (2)
abilities.description: The dragon can be spotlighted up to 2 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Sunlit Fury
abilities.description: In direct sunlight, the dragon gains +2 Difficulty and adds 2 to damage from its attacks.

abilities.name: Solar Breath
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 15. On a failure, take 2d8+4 magic damage and clinging solar fire forces the target to mark 1 Stress. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the dragon marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
